name: Good
overview: Scripture reveals that good originates from God, who saw the light as good and separates it from darkness (Genesis 1:4), emphasizing the inherent goodness of His creation. The Psalms invite believers to trust in the Lord’s goodness and mercy, encouraging them to do good and live righteously (Psalms 34:8; 37:3; 100:5). Isaiah warns against confusing good with evil, underscoring the importance of discerning true goodness as defined by God’s standards (Isaiah 5:20). This foundation informs subtopics such as living as good Christians, exemplifying godly character, and fulfilling roles like fatherhood and husbandry in alignment with God’s goodness.
